steps.why: Review failed (round 1 of 3). T8.1 is blocking: this branch introduced 31 failing tests across 11 files in six other approved feature suites, and npx tsc --noEmit exits 1 with 8 TS2741 errors. Fix the fixtures to assert the new intended behaviour; do not weaken assertions and do not revert the Next 16 params signature (CON-705). Done when tsc exits 0 and the full vitest run is green.

Re-run review at remediation round 2 once T8.1, T8.2, and T8.3 are complete. Review.md currently reads Status: FAIL.
